# Agent targets and generated files

`spego init` generates agent-facing files for every target listed under `agents` in `.spego/config.yaml`. Run `spego skills` to regenerate them without reinitializing the workspace.

## Agents (universal)

The `agents` target writes skills following the open [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) layout, so any compliant tool reads them:

- `.agents/skills/spego-<command>/SKILL.md` — one skill per spego command
- `.agents/skills/spego-<workflow>/SKILL.md` — one skill per workflow

Each skill teaches the agent to run the underlying command (`spego <name> --json [options]`); the skill descriptions are what the agent matches against the conversation.

Two install paths produce the same skills from the same source:

1. `spego skills` — renders the skills into the current project's `.agents/skills/` from the registries compiled into the installed spego version.
2. `npx skills add victorzhuk/spego` — installs the skills committed to the repository's `skills/` tree through the [skills CLI](https://github.com/antfu/skills-cli), optionally wiring symlinks into tool-specific directories (`--agent claude-code`, `--agent opencode`, …) or installing globally (`-g`).

The repository's `skills/` tree is generated by the same templates `spego skills` uses (`npm run skills` regenerates it; `test/generator.source.test.ts` fails on drift), so both paths deliver byte-identical skill files.

## OpenCode

- `.opencode/commands/spego-apply.md` — implements pending tasks from an OpenSpec change in the active OpenCode instance
- `.opencode/commands/spego-verify.md` — checks completeness, correctness, coherence, and tests before archive
- `.opencode/commands/spego-explore.md` — a read-only exploration stance for ideas, problems, or OpenSpec changes

`/spego-apply` runs as a phased current-session workflow: select the change, load context, plan tasks, execute work, verify results, update task checkboxes, summarize status. It may use OpenCode-native subagents only inside the active OpenCode instance, for independent investigation, implementation review, or verification.

### Scope

spego does not start or control OpenCode through `opencode serve`, does not call the OpenCode REST API, does not create external OpenCode sessions, and does not own model selection. Configure models, variants, agents, and permissions in OpenCode itself.

There are no `spego apply`, `spego verify`, `spego explore`, or `spego orchestrate` CLI commands. Apply, verify, and explore are generated OpenCode workflows; spego remains the local artifact engine and read-only OpenSpec delivery view.

## Legacy targets

`claude` remains accepted as a target name and resolves to `agents` (a note is printed in human output; update `agents` in `.spego/config.yaml`). Regeneration also migrates off the pre-v0.29 layout: spego-generated files under `.claude/skills/spego-*/` and `.claude/commands/spego/` are removed, including the retired slash-command wrappers. Files without the `spego_generated: true` marker are user-owned and are never touched.

## Regeneration and stale files

During regeneration spego removes stale generated files — skills the registry no longer names (retired commands, old `opsx-*` commands, `openspec-*` skills) — only when they carry the `spego_generated: true` marker. User-owned files without that marker are preserved and reported as skipped.
